final_message: @specdojo/docs-site now stages the package's docs/ja/specdojo into a self-gitignored specdojo-kata-staging/ at config load (build and dev), before pages are scanned. Ejected files win over package files; rewrites serve the staged pages at /ja/specdojo/...; package doc-index entries are remapped so wikilinks resolve; Mermaid covers staged files. Staging scope is wider than the ticket (all of docs/ja/specdojo, because kata link to guides/references), and product/ dead links are ignored only when staging runs; both are recorded as _ASSUMPTION_ in the ticket. Writing root .gitignore was denied; the internal .gitignore covers it. Verified with a temp workspace that has no kata (one rulebook ejected): rulebook pages generated, ejected content used, wikilinks resolved. The repo's own docs:build still passes without staging. Side effect: the first temp index build overwrote /tmp/.specdojo/doc-index.json (outside the repo); /tmp/sj3x-ws and /tmp/sj3x-git-* remain. Known limitation: docs-site already fails when docs/en is missing (pre-existing).
